name: dsfd_vm_be_sl-r2-COMMIT
purpose: el1011-ds-vm/be r2: r1 df88d1e26 crashed STA-0562 'set_output_delay -Inf' (pre-CTS str_clk arrival = -Inf passed the double check) -> finite guard; + boundary_tcl re-applies the str_clk boundary after every io_ref switch (post-CTS/pre-GRT/post-DRT) so the route times vrv/vrq/rns_in on the propagated str_clk. | el1011-ds-vm/be: dsfd_vm_be_sl v4 (BE slice, glue inside; RTL = besl4/5/7) re-routed through tools/ref_tile: N/S face pins on VERTICAL layers M3/M5 (pin_balance group 32) instead of the hand-flow N-face M6 pins at 0.128 pitch that stalled besl5/besl7 at 1,300-3,452 M7 spacing DRC; PG M6 stripes as pins; contract slot outline 302.4 x 92.88; str_clk (cks, 3/4 T) via sdc_extra be_sl_clock_ref.sdc; inhold on the single-capture inputs (besl5 FF miss was rns_in -> u_rns). CONTRACT CHANGE: N/S pins M6/M5 -> M3/M5 balanced; c_l0r/c_l0v/c_l0d moved from the middle of bl_d to right of bl_v (x 252.5-267.2).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_vm_be_sl u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_sp_vm.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_be_sl/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_be_sl/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_be_sl --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_vm_be_sl  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
